def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    # find 3-region rows
    rows3=[r for r in range(h) if any(v==3 for v in g[r])]
    r0,r1=min(rows3),max(rows3)
    band_h=r1-r0+1  # 4
    # shape column-boxes per band
    def band_cols(a,b):
        cols=set()
        for r in range(a,b+1):
            for c,v in enumerate(g[r]):
                if v==2: cols.add(c//5*5)
        return cols
    above=band_cols(r0-band_h-1, r0-2)   # band above (with blank row between)
    below=band_cols(r1+2, r1+band_h+1)
    stamp=above & below
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(w): g[r][c]=0
    for col in stamp:
        for r in range(band_h):
            for c in range(w):
                v=g[r0-band_h-1+r][c]
                if v==2: g[r0+r][c]=2
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]==2 and r%6==0 and c%6==0: g[r][c]=8
    return g

    # shape box width: from first band, cols of 2s grouped
    cols2=sorted({c for v,c in [(v,c) for r in bands[0] for c,v in enumerate(g[r])] if v==2})
    boxes=[];

    bw = boxes[1][0]-boxes[0][0] if len(boxes)>1 else None
    # extract canonical shape from first band first box
    b0 = bands[0]; box0 = range(boxes[0][0], boxes[0][0]+ (bw if bw else len(boxes[0])))
    shape=[[(r-b0[0], c-boxes[0][0]) for c in range(boxes[0][0], boxes[0][0]+(bw if bw else 3)) for r in b0 if g[r][c]==2]]
    shape=shape[0]
    bh = max(r for r,_ in shape)-min(r for r,_ in shape)+1
    sh_w = max(c for _,c in shape)-min(c for _,c in shape)+1
    if bw is None: bw = sh_w
    sb = sb if sb else bh+1
    # region: contiguous rows that are all-3 -> horizontal strip; contiguous cols all-3 -> vertical
    all3_rows=[r for r in range(h) if all(g[r][c]==3 for c in range(w))]
    all3_cols=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==3 for r in range(h))]
    p = sb+1  # lattice period

        # choose closest to center of mass of existing shapes
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==2]
        mr=sum(r for r,_ in pts)/len(pts); mc=sum(c for _,c in pts)/len(pts)

        rands=[r for r in rands if r % sb == 0]
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==2]
        mr=sum(r for r,_ in pts)/len(pts); mc=sum(c for _,c in pts)/len(pts)

        for c in all3_cols:

        for dr,dc in shape: g[best+dr][cb+dc]=2
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]==2 and r%p==0 and c%p==0: g[r][c]=8
    return g

def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    rows2=sorted({r for r in range(h) if any(v==2 for v in g[r])})
    bands=[]
    for r in rows2:
        if bands and r==bands[-1][-1]+1: bands[-1].append(r)
        else: bands.append([r])
    starts=[b[0] for b in bands]
    sb = min(b-a for a,b in zip(starts,starts[1:])) if len(starts)>1 else None
    cols2=sorted({c for r in bands[0] for c,v in enumerate(g[r]) if v==2})
    boxes=[]
    for c in cols2:
        if boxes and c-boxes[-1][-1]<=1: boxes[-1].append(c)
        else: boxes.append([c])
    bstarts=[b[0] for b in boxes]
    bw = min(b-a for a,b in zip(bstarts,bstarts[1:])) if len(bstarts)>1 else None
    b0=bands[0]
    sw = bw if bw else len(boxes[0])
    shape=[(r-b0[0], c-boxes[0][0]) for r in b0 for c in range(boxes[0][0], boxes[0][0]+sw) if g[r][c]==2]
    bh = max(r for r,_ in shape)-min(r for r,_ in shape)+1
    shw = max(c for _,c in shape)-min(c for _,c in shape)+1
    if bw is None: bw = shw
    if sb is None: sb = bh+1
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==2]
    mr=sum(r for r,_ in pts)/len(pts); mc=sum(c for _,c in pts)/len(pts)
    all3_rows=[r for r in range(h) if all(g[r][c]==3 for c in range(w))]
    all3_cols=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==3 for r in range(h))]
    p = sb+1
    if all3_rows:
        rb = all3_rows[0]
        cands=[c0 for c0 in range(0, w-shw+1, sb)
               if all(g[r][c0+cc] in (0,3) for r in all3_rows for cc in range(shw))]
        best=min(cands, key=lambda c0: (abs(rb+bh/2-mr), abs(c0+shw/2-mc)))
        for r in all3_rows: g[r]=[0]*w
        for dr,dc in shape: g[rb+dr][best+dc]=2
    else:
        cb = all3_cols[0]
        cands=[r0 for r0 in range(0, h-bh+1, sb)
               if all(g[r0+dr][c] in (0,3) for dr in range(bh) for c in all3_cols)]
        best=min(cands, key=lambda r0: (abs(cb+shw/2-mc), abs(r0+bh/2-mr)))
        for c in all3_cols:
            for r in range(h): g[r][c]=0
        for dr,dc in shape: g[best+dr][cb+dc]=2
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]==2 and r%p==0 and c%p==0: g[r][c]=8
    return g

def feat(p,pos):
    b,x=pos; S=p['shapes']; kind,i=p['region']
    band=[xx for bb,xx in S if bb==b]; col=[bb for bb,xx in S if xx==x]
    f={}
    f['b']=b; f['x']=x; f['s']=b+x; f['d']=b-x
    f['nband']=len(band); f['ncol']=len(col)
    f['adj_band']=(x-1 in band)+(x+1 in band)
    f['adj_col']=(b-1 in col)+(b+1 in col)
    f['diag']=((b-1,x-1) in S)+((b-1,x+1) in S)+((b+1,x-1) in S)+((b+1,x+1) in S)
    f['has_col']=int(len(col)>0)
    f['col_min']=min(col) if col else -9; f['col_max']=max(col) if col else -9
    f['band_min']=min(band) if band else -9; f['band_max']=max(band) if band else -9
    f['band_count_eq_ncol']=int(len(band)==len(col))

    f['s+1']=b+x+1
    f['dsign']= (1 if b-x>0 else -1 if b-x<0 else 0)
    f['ncol_full']=int(len(col)==p['nb']-1)
    f['nband_full']=int(len(band)==p['nx']-1)
    return f
